audit_items.proof_trace: The emode group total borrow limit is enforced at every borrow via `update_asset_borrow` (emode.move:183-192) followed by `assert!(emode_group_total_borrow.le(emode_max_borrow_amount))` at market.move:422. In Sui Move, a failed `assert!` aborts the transaction atomically, rolling back the preceding state mutation so no limit-exceeding borrow can persist. The single external borrow entry point (`borrow.move:51`) always routes through `handle_borrow`, with no bypass paths; flash loans are excluded from `assets_borrows` tracking as they must be repaid within the same transaction.
